description: This file defines the 'MyReviewMenuConfigurator' class, which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring a menu item or screen override related to performance reviews within the OrangeHRM system's performance module.

classes.name: MyReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration logic for the performance review feature, overriding the screen to 'myPerformanceReview'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen with 'myPerformanceReview' for the current module context.
